subject: How to specify a subset of CEL files with AffymetrixCelSet$fromName

messages.author: 1b71523bc7711ba8
messages.subject: How to specify a subset of CEL files with AffymetrixCelSet$fromName
parts:
I would like to use only a subset of .Cel files in a particular folder
of raw data. Is it possible to specify which .Cel files are used in
the preprocessing function?

Thanks for your help.

Matt

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] How to specify a subset of CEL files with AffymetrixCelSet$fromName
parts:
On Tue, May 20, 2008 at 10:50 AM, Matt <matt.k...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> I would like to use only a subset of .Cel files in a particular folder
> of raw data. Is it possible to specify which .Cel files are used in
> the preprocessing function?

When I do this, I typically "load" the complete set and then use extract(), e.g.

ds <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName("MyData", tags="foo", chipType="GenomeWideSNP_6");
ds <- extract(ds, c(1,4,5,7:12,15));

or by name patterns, e.g.

pattern <- "^SomePattern[0-9]{2}.*";
idxs <- grep(pattern, getNames(ds));
ds <- extract(ds, idxs);

That will give you an AffymetrixCelSet referencing only a subset of the arrays.

The following step will the operate only on these arrays, e.g.

qn <- QuantileNormalization(ds, tags="*,subsetA");
csN <- process(qn);

It is recommended to add a tag to the output (normalized) data set as
illustrated, so that you create a completely "orthogonal" set of files
and data set full name avoiding all conflicts with same analysis on a
different subset.

Hope this helps

Henrik
